name: Block Mesh Alpha Rendering
definition: A rendering technique for voxel-based environments that uses a custom index ordering algorithm to sort visible faces back-to-front relative to the camera's primary viewing axis, enabling correct alpha blending without full scene depth sorting.
summary: Block Mesh Alpha Rendering sorts pre-generated chunk meshes back-to-front along the camera's primary axis to enable correct alpha blending in voxel environments without modifying mesh geometry.
